overall: Resolved by informal action: the AG found the Commission violated the law by not recording the posting date and time on its April 25, 2013 notice and by failing to answer the complaint within 14 business days; the Town Clerk allegation was declined as she is not a public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 25, 2013 meeting notice did not conspicuously record the date and time it was posted.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to conspicuously record thereon or therewith the date and time that its April 25, 2013 meeting notice was posted.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the original complaint: the Commission did not respond to the complaint within 14 business days, responding about two and a half months later.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, while it was not raised in the original complaint, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law for failing to respond to the complaint within fourteen (14) business days.

allegations.summary: Complaint also alleged that the Town Clerk, an individual public employee, violated the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to review the allegations against her and only consider her actions to the extent they relate to the complaint against the Commission.
